name: BESE v3 — Spatial Letter Encoding
author: Omer Bese
summary: Novel byte-level tokenizer where every English letter has a 3D coordinate derived from FineWeb bigram MDS. The same coordinates do double duty: spatial-scored BPE merge selection (score = freq * exp(-d / 3sigma) ** 0.02) AND embedding-table init (first 12 dims of each letter row). First submission to use one geometric prior across both tokenizer and model init. Architecture identical to PR #1666 — only the tokenizer + embedding init change.
tokenizer: BESE v3 spatial (47 base + 241 BPE = 288 vocab)
architecture: Transformer with depth recurrence (layers 3-5, 3 loops), parallel residuals (layer 8+), QK-gain 5.25
evaluation: INT6 + sliding window (stride 64) + n-gram tilt + score-first TTT

spatial_init.scope: 26 letter tokens (rows 4-29), first 12 dims overwritten with fitted coords; rest of row keeps Gaussian init

spatial_bpe.fallback_to_freq: for pairs where either token has no spatial coord (special, punct, digit, or merges thereof)

v3_vs_v2_control.delta_attribution: Architecture, optimizer, quantization, eval pipeline are identical between v2 and v3. Any BPB delta is attributable to tokenizer + embedding init only.

notes: Single-seed non-record submission. Submitted under the rule that allows in-progress / novel-idea work. Three-seed validation, Turkish-corpus comparative test, and higher-vocab variants are pending compute credits (see README Ongoing Work section). Prep is untimed: ~30-50 min for coord optimization + BPE training + shard re-encoding + ngram table; Phase 1 training is the standard 600s cap on 8xH100 SXM.
